custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'lace' pattern. AI often generates 'fake lace' where holes don't connect or threads float in mid-air. Verify if the knit pattern is topologically sound. Also, check if the shadows under the socks are consistent with a single light source, as flat-lay items often have inconsistent grounding in AI images.
